data.long_meaning: The name Lyndel is a combination of the names Lynn and Delia. In Greek mythology, Delia is a name associated with the god Apollo and the goddess Artemis. The name Lynn comes from the Old English word 'lynne', meaning 'pool, pond'. This name may be considered a modern variant of Lindsay, which means 'linden tree'. The name Lyndel carries the meaning “Lynn + delia” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lyndel usually hope their child will grow to embody lynn + delia and live with faith, good character and purpose.
